title: Greetings and goodbyes
subtitle: あいさつ
review: Burmese lines drafted by Claude. Check them before publishing.
intro: The phrases you need on day one. Listen, repeat, and do not worry about the writing.

tr.my: မင်္ဂလာနံနက်ခင်းပါ။

lines.note: Until about 10 am. To friends: Ohayō.

tr.my: မင်္ဂလာပါ။
မင်္ဂလာညနေခင်းပါ။
တွေ့ရတာ ဝမ်းသာပါတယ်။

lines.note: Only the first time you meet someone.

lines.kana: よろしくおねがいします。

tr.en: Pleased to meet you. / I'm in your care.
tr.my: ခင်ခင်မင်မင် ဆက်ဆံပေးပါ။

lines.kana: ありがとうございます。

tr.my: ကျေးဇူးတင်ပါတယ်။
တဆိတ်လောက်။ / တောင်းပန်ပါတယ်။

lines.note: Also used to call a waiter or to thank someone for their trouble.

tr.my: နောက်မှ တွေ့မယ်။

tr.en: Goodbye. (polite, leaving work or a room)

lines.note: Said to colleagues all day long, and when leaving.

questions.q: You meet your new boss for the first time. What do you say?
questions.why: Hajimemashite is for a first meeting. Follow it with your name and Yoroshiku onegaishimasu.

questions.q: It is 8 pm. You walk into a restaurant.
A colleague is going home. What do you say?
questions.why: Otsukaresama desu thanks a colleague for the day's work.
